source.content: Decimal value = Decimal.valueOf('-12.3456'); System.assertEquals(true, value.equals(value)); System.assertNotEquals(null, value.hashCode()); System.assertEquals('12.3456', value.abs().toString()); System.assertEquals(12, value.abs().intValue()); System.assertEquals(12, value.abs().longValue()); System.assertEquals(-12.3456, value.doubleValue()); System.assertEquals('-12.3456', value.toString()); System.assertEquals(true, value.equals(Decimal.valueOf('-12.3456'))); System.assertEquals(1.25, Decimal.valueOf('5').divide(Decimal.valueOf('4'), 2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP)); System.assertEquals('1.953125', Decimal.valueOf('1.25').pow(3).toString()); System.assertEquals(13, Decimal.valueOf('12.6').round()); System.assertEquals('12.35', Decimal.valueOf('12.3456').setScale(2).toString()); System.assertEquals(42, Decimal.valueOf(42).intValue()); System.assertEquals('42.125', Decimal.valueOf('42.125').toString());
